main_text.p: nati fuerunt super genua Iosephi.] Onkelos, אתוילידו [?] ורבו [?], nati fuerunt, & educavit (eos Ioseph. Huc astipulatur R.Sal. בחרגו גרלן בין ברכיו [?], i.e. quemadmodum Chaldaeus interpretatus est, educavit eos inter genua sua. Jonathan, nescio quare ad circumcisionem eorum a Iosepho procuratam, refert, כד אתוילידו גוירינן יוסף [?], quando nati fuerunt, circumcidit eos Ioseph. Hoc innuere videtur eos a Iosepho in domum familiamque suam fuisse accitos.
[Hebrew] Et aromatibus condierunt eum.] LXX, Ver.26. [Greek] & sepelierunt eum. Melius in- [Greek], ut ver.2.

page.notes: The scan is very faint and blurred. Many lines above the rule and below the ornament are illegible; I have marked them by length. Hebrew and Greek words are approximations, each marked [?]. The rule and ornament row are not text. The faint "Vers.5" at the right edge is marginal but unreadable enough to omit. The page is also shadowed by show-through from the facing page.
